utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the timing and where we’re meeting first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — we’re meeting at the community shed at 3 PM on Saturday. I’ve got a few tools you can borrow if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me, as long as I know which tools you’re bringing and how long we’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Faye. It’s Saturday at 10, over by my garage if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 by your garage works for me—I’ll plan around the school schedule and be there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, it’s coming along fine — they’re still collecting donations and lining up volunteers. I’ve only skimmed it, but it sounds like we’re just waiting on a few final repairs.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive and keep things moving. What do you want to tackle first, Mara?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the list of needed repairs and who can handle each one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help out—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey—I'm running a bit late, but I can still help with whatever’s left. What’s the biggest thing you need done?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The biggest thing is sorting the list of repairs and checking which homes still need a hand. If you can, I could use help matching folks to the right jobs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help, but I’d like to check the details first—what exactly do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We need basic repair supplies—tools, tape, screws, and a few sturdy boxes. If you can help sort or bring any of that, it’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can do that. I’ll sort through what I have and bring any tools, tape, screws, and sturdy boxes I can find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a little reminder of what we’re fixing and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re fixing up the community shed and a few loose fence panels this Saturday morning. Come by around 10 and I’ll point you to the tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — community shed and fence panels this Saturday around 10. I’ll be there, and if I forget, I’ll ask you again!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yeah, I’m in — just point me to what needs fixing and when.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send you the list and the time right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any repair-drive details yet, but I can help keep track of the location if you tell me where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know where the repair drive is being held?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not yet—I don’t have the location confirmed. If you tell me where it’s being held, I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll do the same and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I appreciate it — I’ll spread the word if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed a detail or two; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are you still bringing the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’m still bringing it today — thanks for checking.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Eli. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. I’d like you to help sort donations and keep a simple list of what comes in, then we can see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I can sort the donations and keep a simple list of everything that comes in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still checking the time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it. If you can, just bring any tools you already have and a little patience.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No problem—I’ll keep my tools handy and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, just let me know if you spot anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re short on screws, duct tape, and a couple flashlights. If you can bring any of that, it’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring screws and duct tape for sure. I’ll check if I have a flashlight too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to bring their requests.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — that really helps. I’ll spread the word and send any requests your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Leo — I’ll get a simple list going and keep it updated so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—tell me what needs doing, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put you down to help or just come by?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Just come by—I can help out for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m headed to the repair drive now, Nell—if you need me, I’ll be near the check-in table.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal—I'll probably stop by a little later and check the table. Let me know if you hear anything I should know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do, Nell—I'll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes at the check-in table.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help, if you still need a hand with it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I do still need a hand. I’m planning to sort the donations and set up the table later today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can help sort the donations and set up the table later today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge things for the repair drive—who still needs to be looped in?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think a couple folks still need the heads-up, but I’m a bit fuzzy on who exactly. I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — just send me the names when you have them, and I’ll help with the follow-up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout—folks really showed up for it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s been a nice turnout. If anyone needs a tool, I’ve got a few they can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s so kind of you, Gus—people will really appreciate that. I’ll spread the word to anyone who still needs a tool.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort donations and keep an eye on any tools we lend out?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — who’s handling the tools log, and where should I start with the donations?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll handle the tools log, and you can start by the donation table near the entrance. Please note anything you lend out so we can keep track.
